regimeSub: Warsh holds rates but 3 FOMC members voted hike; BOK eyes Aug hike as Mideast uncertainty persists.
themes: Fed Chair Warsh holds rates unchanged (Jul 29) but 3 dissents voted hike → hints 'Big Picture' Jackson Hole speech, says 'not constrained by market prices' signaling hawkish tilt despite hold
BOK Governor Rhee signals Aug hike likely (Korea Times Jul 30) after Jul 16 hike to 2.75% → Fed hold 'intensifies uncertainty' per BOK; USDKRW easing to 1446 as rate differential narrows
Brent +$2.13 to $89.79 as Mideast tensions resurface despite Hormuz reopening (Jun 15) → oil settling at pre-war levels per Reuters (Jul 6) but geopolitical risk premium rebuilding
Consumer confidence falls (Jul 29) despite retail 'defying gravity' per NRF → VIX elevated at 20.66 as FOMC dissent + slowing payrolls (Jun NFP +57k vs forecast) raise stagflation concerns
